summary: Web-only frontend verification of the New Look V2 feature set (variant lock + admin appearance + V2 soft-launch admin + V2 merchant portal band + V2 cashier POS + regression). All four required changes verified. VARIANT LOCK: anonymous and consumer (freeuser@) never see [data-testid=variant-switcher-btn] even when forcing ?design=legacy | classic_b | radiolife — V2 shell renders (screenshot confirmed). Merchant shell also carries data-variant=new_look_v2. ADMIN: /admin/appearance renders admin-appearance-page with 4 options; new_look_v2 is active (admin-appearance-active-new_look_v2). AdminHome header shows variant-switcher-btn and Quick Links admin-home-ql-appearance / admin-home-ql-softlaunch. SOFT-LAUNCH: /admin/soft-launch renders admin-soft-launch-page with all 4 tabs (all_pending/approved/launch_ready/readiness). Readiness tab shows admin-soft-launch-readiness with admin-soft-launch-readiness-pct = 0% (correctly computed from 0/0 approved-stripe-complete). all_pending currently returns EMPTY (no live pending applications), so we could not visually assert approve/reject rows exist per real merchant — code-review confirms admin-soft-launch-approve-<id> / admin-soft-launch-reject-<id> are correctly wired and the reject flow uses window.prompt (canceled properly). PORTAL BAND: /merchant/dashboard renders merchant-portal-band-v2 with band-name = merchant name, band-readiness '75% ready' (real computation from name/logo/stripe fields), and all three actions merchant-portal-complete-setup / merchant-portal-preview-store / merchant-portal-switch-workspace. Switch Workspace navigates to /portal. CASHIER: /merchant/cashier renders merchant-cashier-pos-header (with merchant name), merchant-cashier-scan-card, merchant-cashier-code-input, merchant-cashier-scan-btn; submitting invalid code 'BIGFM-INVALID-XYZ' shows merchant-cashier-error-card with label 'Coupon code not found'. REGRESSION: /portal/login renders with portal-login-* fields; workspace-switcher-trigger present on merchant shell; /portal chooser regression from iter152 unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: MerchantShell.jsx: PortalBandV2 is only rendered when variant==='new_look_v2', which is the correct spec, but the band is placed on EVERY inner merchant page (Overview, Cashier, Transactions, etc.) via <Outlet/>. On the cashier page this means the admin/premium band sits above the POS scan card — visually acceptable but worth confirming the design intent (some POS UIs prefer no admin chrome).

MerchantShell.jsx `refresh()` (context.refresh) always reassigns data.items[0] and ignores the bigfm_active_workspace, so after a workspace switch a manual refresh() would silently swap the current merchant to the first-owned one. Not a Phase-1 blocker.

AdminSoftLaunch.jsx computes counts.launch_ready from `stripe_onboarding_status==='complete' || effective_status==='active'`, but MarketReadiness explains 'have completed Stripe onboarding' — the label undersells effective_status==='active' cases without Stripe onboarding info (minor copy/logic mismatch).
AdminAppearance.jsx OPTIONS list is defined in-module and duplicated shape with VariantSwitcher.jsx; consider centralising to a single source of truth to prevent drift.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executable checks (17/17); 1 non-executable — cannot visually confirm approve/reject rows because all_pending is currently empty
